name: dev.remesh.unity-connector
description: RE:Mesh brings a 3D asset catalogue inside the Unity editor. Browse the catalogue in an editor window, turn typed knobs to remix models live, preview the result, and import it into your project as a .glb with your colours baked in. Also ships a runtime API for streaming and remixing assets at play time. Every parameter name, label, range, option and palette is read from the asset's own machine-readable schema — nothing is invented client-side.

samples.description: Loads the catalogue at play time, spawns an asset and drives a knob from script. Start here if you want RE:Mesh assets in a running game rather than imported into the project.
